sourceFile: 22. TIU C11-20  Reportfind reason NG function high 2025.12.24_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it conflates multiple test conditions and uses invalid controls across unrelated groups.
issues: Changed factor combines distinct tests into one comparison.
Baseline/test assignments are often wrong or unrelated.
Date, shift, model side, and test type grouping is not preserved.
Measurement outcome is a spurious parse of defect table columns.
Key comparator rows are omitted while header/unclear rows are cited.
correctionPlan: Rebuild as one report with separate changed factors for each stated test type.
Pair each test only with its matching normal/control row within the same date, model side, shift, and note context.
Separate VP KR, no cooling fan, no ethanol cleaning, line swap, grill hand, laser cutting, and dry-12h forming results.
Remove measurement-stat outcome unless real measurement rows exist.
Cite only section, condition, and compared data rows needed for each factor.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove row existence but are insufficient for final evidence because grouping and comparator citations are unsafe.
